Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

International Benefit Anniversary Concert for the 45th Anniversary of CMI

May 1, 2026 · St. Thekla, Ochsenfurt

Festive benefit anniversary concert for the 45th anniversary of CMI with international guests from Ochsenfurt, Padua, Giebelstadt, and Würzburg.
Admission free. Donations in support of Mbonda Lokito Kongo/Kinshasa Kinderhilfe e.V. and Würzburg Ukraine Aid.
